Nine (9%) of 101 firefighters had positive TST results
All QFT-G test results from blood samples collected from the nine firefighters were negative.
annual incidence in the state overall was 3.9 per 100,000, and U.S. incidence was 4.6 per 100,000
NIOSH received a request for a health hazard evaluation from a fire department in Mississippi.

methods_quotes.q: The nine firefighters with positive TST results were interviewed by NIOSH personnel to assess their personal and occupational risk factors
seven of nine available firefighters were retested with Tubersol brand tuberculin as part of the NIOSH evaluation
Medical staff members at the local hospital who administered the firefighter two-step TSTs were interviewed to compare their protocols with CDC guidelines
